hook_formula: Absurd High-Concept Premise + Instant Visual Payoff: Immediately establishes a supernatural ruleset ('Every time I talk to my crush, something falls from the sky') paired with rapid visual escalation (flowerpot to piano) within 3 seconds, triggering curiosity about why it happens.
story_arc:
Setup: Confesses strange rule where speaking to crush causes objects to fall from the sky.
Escalation: Objects grow larger (flower pot -> bathtub -> piano -> canoe -> shopping cart) as he tries workarounds (helmets, middleman, phone calls) while noting mystery clues (bell sound, scratch marks).
Twist & Payoff: Confesses in person, spots her cat on the roof pushing a car; girl says yes to the date, prompting the cat to drop a rose instead of a car.

camera_patterns: mcu -> wide -> low_angle -> high_angle -> close_up -> tilt_up

character_archetypes.outfit_style: Green-and-black striped long sleeve sweater with black pants and spiky green hair
Black preppy blazer uniform with pleated skirt and white thigh-high socks
Orange striped blocky cat avatar with red collar

visual_gags_and_fx: Scratch mark texture overlay on bathtub prop
Cat pushing full-size red sports car off roof

source_transcript: Every time I talked to my crush, something falls from the sky. Yesterday it was a piano. It started small. Hi! Gotta flower pot. Can I borrow a pencil? Gotta bathtub. Then we talked about homework for one whole minute. That was the piano. She never ran away. I almost did. The longer I talked, the bigger it gets. And I still haven't asked her out. I tried wearing three helmets. I sent my best friend to ask for me. A canoe landed on him. I called her from my bedroom. A shopping cart came through my ceiling. Two things bugged me. Right before every crash I heard a tiny bell. And everything that fell had scratch marks on it. So today I went to her house and asked anyway. Will you go out with? I heard the bell. I looked up. Her cat was on the roof pushing a car toward the edge. It had been the cat all year. She looked up too. Don't! She told the cat. I'm saying yes. The cat stared at me for a long time. Then it pushed something off the roof anyway. A rose.
